title: 仅5%持股：拿下整个董事会，四十年CEO为何出局？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Elsewhere, as well, Ethan Allen announcing leadership changes after activist investor DGB investments gained majority control of the board last week.
segments.zh: 另外，Ethan Allen宣布领导层变动，此前维权市场参与者DGB**上周获得了董事会多数控制权。

segments.en: Former Neiman Marcus executive Stephanie Chen Ward taking over his interim CEO and DGB investments founder Doug Bergeron becoming the board's executive chairman, he spoke here on Open Interest last month.
segments.zh: 前Neiman Marcus高管Stephanie Chen Ward接任临时CEO，DGB**创始人Doug Bergeron成为董事会执行主席，他上个月在Open Interest节目中发言。

segments.en: Our team has set out an underday plan. We also have a five year plan.
segments.zh: 我们的团队已经制定了一项短期计划。我们还有一项五年计划。

segments.en: Mr. Ward is an extraordinary leader. Mr. O'Glock took way fares sales using omnichannel and digital strategies and AI from 250 million to 12 billion over 12 years.
segments.zh: Ward先生是一位非凡的领导者。O'Glock先生通过全渠道、数字战略和人工智能，在12年内将销售额从2.5亿美元提升至120亿美元。

segments.en: So there is no question that there will be very significant changes right up front and long term as well.
segments.zh: 因此毫无疑问，短期内和长期内都将发生非常重大的变化。

segments.en: And Bergeron got those changes that he wanted joining us now is Bloomberg activist investing reporter Munchy's son.
segments.zh: Bergeron得到了他想要的那些变化，现在加入我们的是彭博维权**记者Munchy's son。

segments.en: What is all good? And you've been doing such a great job tracking this. Can you just walk us through the timeline of how we got to this point of Farouk, the CEO ousted a new one coming in?
segments.zh: 一切顺利吗？你一直做得很好，跟踪这件事。你能带我们梳理一下时间线吗，我们是如何走到Farouk这位CEO被罢免、新人接任这一步的？

segments.en: Yeah, thanks for having me. You know, we've been covering this. It's very beginning. You interviewed Doug on the Bloomberg deal show about when he, you know, disclosed a stake back in August.
segments.zh: 是的，感谢邀请。我们一直在报道这件事，从一开始就关注。你在彭博Deal节目中采访了Doug，关于他去年8月披露持股的情况。

segments.en: And for the very beginning, he wanted to nominate the entire force later board. He said, you know, Ethan Allen is a really good brand, has good manufacturing, good balance sheet, but it's really just been mismanaged for a very long time.
segments.zh: 从一开始，他就想提名整个董事会。他说，Ethan Allen是一个非常好的品牌，有好的制造能力、好的资产负债表，但长期以来管理不善。
